verdict.rationale: AgentMail does not document a built-in natural-language interface, but its own first-party integrations let users operate it in natural language through agent clients. The Google ADK integration explicitly lets an agent create inboxes, send and receive email, and manage threads "using natural language." The hosted MCP server and the agent skills expose inbox, message, thread and draft tools to clients like Claude Code and Cursor. The language understanding itself comes from the host agent, not AgentMail. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command surface in the product or console, and independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: your agent can create inboxes, send and receive emails, manage threads, and handle attachments using natural language.
AgentMail runs a hosted MCP server at `https://mcp.agentmail.to/mcp` that exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
